issues.quote: all those who laid in my heart, as in their own hiding place, their hopes, their anger and their suffering, or the bloody cruelty of the beast
or the bloody cruelty of the beast
It is you, from whom the blood ran out through a small hole made by a soldier’s bullet
I chased the news of a row of white sacks with a ripe plum
I have not a single drop of warm blood left even for those living dead among whom you walk like a bloody specter.
One after another, and a third, and so on without end.

strengths.quote: You know, I once read how you were hanged, all twelve of you… All twelve… and I yawned.
I took, you know, a wonderful juicy plum between my fingers… and felt a pleasant, sweet taste in my mouth.
strengths.why: sensory detail makes the guilt sting

strengths.quote: for horror has sucked all the blood out of me
all of them leave the tracks of their soles on my soul
How can I be sure that the door will not open, just a little, with a faint creak
